text: Your product photos are too heavy for your website. Squoosh shrinks them free, right in your browser. Step one. Open squoosh dot app. No account, no sign up. Step two. Drop in a photo. Step three. Drag the divider to compare the original with the smaller copy. Step four. Pick a format like WebP, then slide the quality down while it still looks sharp. Squoosh shows the new file size as you go. Step five. Hit download. Google Chrome Labs built it, and the code is open source. Squoosh says it does not send your image to a server. The limits? There's no paid plan to unlock. Squoosh does use Google Analytics to log basic visitor data and the before and after file sizes. Send this to someone who runs a business.
